(3) Rules of court made under or for the purp oses of Chapter 1 of Part 2 of that Act
apply to relevant proceedings under this Act—
Psychoactive Substances Act 2016 (c. 2)22
(a) to the extent provided by rules of court, and
(b) subject to any modification s provided by rules of court.

(4) Section 47 of that Act (restrictions on reporting special measures directions
etc.) applies with any necessary modifications—
(a) to a direction under section 19 of that Act as applied by this section;
(b) to a direction discharging or varying such a direction.
Sections 49 and 51 of that Act (offences) apply accordingly.

(5) In this section “relevant proc eedings under this Act” means—
(a) proceedings in England and Wales under section 18, 20, 28, 30 or 31,
and
(b) proceedings in England and Wales aris ing by virtue of section 19 or 29.
